summary: Complaints centre on sugarcane dues and flood-related waterlogging and broken roads in Bijnor district, with little Barhapur-specific reporting found, while appreciation is mainly about cane payments and district project announcements.

positives.english: Some sugar mills are paying cane farmers on time.
positives.hindi: कुछ चीनी मिलें गन्ने का भुगतान समय पर कर रही हैं।
positives.basis: District Cane Officer P.N. Singh said nearly six mills in Bijnor district are currently ahead in paying farmers (district-level; the same report shows Rs 195 crore still outstanding at four mills).

positives.english: Cane prices have been raised and payments are said to be on schedule.
positives.hindi: गन्ने का दाम बढ़ा है और भुगतान समय पर होने का दावा किया गया है।
positives.basis: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, speaking in Bijnor, claimed payments to cane growers are on schedule and cane prices were raised. This is a government claim, not voter testimony (district-level).

positives.english: Over Rs 1,000 crore worth of projects were inaugurated in Bijnor.
positives.hindi: बिजनौर में एक हजार करोड़ रुपये से ज्यादा की योजनाएं शुरू हुईं।
positives.basis: CM inaugurated and laid foundation stones for projects worth over Rs 1,003 crore in Bijnor (district-level; no project in Barhapur AC named in the source).

positives.english: Sugar mill crushing is expected to start around 20 October, so cane can be sold sooner.
positives.hindi: चीनी मिलों में पेराई लगभग 20 अक्टूबर से शुरू होने की उम्मीद है।
positives.basis: Crushing expected around October 20, 2026, subject to weather (district-level, western UP mills; source reports Bijnor only as part of a district list).

positives.english: Government hospitals and schools are running in the area.
positives.hindi: सरकारी अस्पताल और स्कूल चल रहे हैं।
positives.basis: Inference: no source opened for Barhapur health or school services. Included only as a field-check item; not supported by any fetched source.

negatives.english: Cane farmers are still owed over Rs 40 crore by Bilai sugar mill.
negatives.hindi: बिलाई चीनी मिल पर गन्ना किसानों का 41 करोड़ रुपये से ज्यादा बकाया है।
negatives.basis: Bilai Sugar Mill owes farmers Rs 41.98 crore; farmer organisations protested and demanded immediate release of dues (district-level, Bijnor district; mill's exact town not stated).

negatives.english: Rain floods the Malan river and cuts the Bijnor-Haridwar road.
negatives.hindi: बारिश में मालन नदी उफनी और बिजनौर-हरिद्वार मार्ग बंद हो गया।
negatives.basis: Malan river in spate after continuous rain; water flowed over the bridge road, Bijnor-Haridwar road fully closed and traffic diverted (district-level; flooding reported near Najibabad, Mandawar; not Barhapur AC).

negatives.english: Floodwater came back onto village roads and state highway for the fourth time this monsoon.
negatives.hindi: इस मानसून में चौथी बार गांव की सड़कों पर फिर पानी भर गया।
negatives.basis: Floodwater returned to village roads and state highway in the Bijnor flood-affected zone; about one foot of standing water; farmers say new water arrives before fields dry (district-level; datelined Jaleelpur, not Barhapur AC).

negatives.english: Rain has wrecked roads, potholes are wider, and the village link road is broken.
negatives.hindi: बारिश से सड़कें टूटीं, गड्ढे बढ़े और गांव का लिंक रोड खराब हुआ।
negatives.basis: Service roads waterlogged due to poor drainage, potholes deepened, and the 3-4 km Mandawali link road (Manjhadi to Lahakkala) badly damaged; no official response reported (district-level; datelined Najibabad/Jalalabad).

negatives.english: Encroachment has lowered the road in Dhampur, so rainwater collects on it.
negatives.hindi: धामपुर में अतिक्रमण से सड़क नीची हो गई, बारिश में पानी भर जाता है।
negatives.basis: Irrigation department said encroachment lowered the road level, causing waterlogging in rain; this is the department's claim as reported, not independently verified (district-level, Dhampur tehsil, same district; not Barhapur AC).

notes: Identity: Wikipedia Barhapur_Assembly_constituency (opened) confirms Constituency No. 19, Bijnor district, reserved status None, parent Moradabad Lok Sabha; area = KCs Barhapur, Pureni, Barhapur NP of Nagina Tehsil and KCs Kadrabad, Afzalgarh & Afzalgarh M.B. of Dhampur Tehsil. Discrepancies: (a) Wikipedia list-of-constituencies extraction read row 19 district as Moradabad; the AC's own article says Bijnor, which is used here, but confirm against the ECI/official delimitation list. (b) Infobox 'elected year 2008' conflicts with body text (first election 2012). Research was incomplete: the WebSearch budget for this run was exhausted after about 20 searches, so no Barhapur-specific (AC-level) local news was found. All negatives are district-level Bijnor sources, not AC-specific, and 2 of them (Malan river and Dhampur) are outside AC 19 territory (Najibabad and Dhampur). Positive 5 is an inference with no source and should be dropped or verified in the field. Positives are thin and partly government claims rather than voter views. Suggested field checks: Barhapur NP drainage and water supply; Pureni and Kadrabad village roads; Afzalgarh (Dhampur tehsil) roads and law and order; stray cattle and crop damage; Nagina-side Ganga/Malan flood villages; Hindi local searches on Amar Ujala and Dainik Jagran Bijnor pages with 'बरहापुर' plus issue terms. Electoral data (2017/2022 results) deliberately excluded per brief.
